purpose: Deterministic virtual-workspace builtins shared by modular Windows, Linux, and Android hosts.

common_contract.cwd: non-root canonical virtual path supplied by the host
common_contract.outputs: bounded binary stdout/stderr; diagnostics never echo rejected operands, host paths, backend text, or secrets
common_contract.host_authority: no host filesystem, process, PTY, PATH, locale, environment lookup, policy, approval, or audit access

commands.name: pwd
deviations: -P/--physical is rejected because a virtual workspace has no host physical cwd

commands.name: echo
commands.effects: joins literal arguments with spaces and optionally interprets the bounded escape set
commands.binary: argument bytes are preserved as UTF-8; newline is optional
deviations: no shell expansion, locale, or host state

commands.name: printf
commands.effects: renders the bounded literal format/conversion subset
commands.binary: byte-oriented format output; no Unicode or locale conversion
deviations: no floating point, dynamic width/precision, locale grouping, or shell expansion

commands.name: cat
commands.effects: reads virtual files or one caller-owned stdin cursor
commands.binary: raw file/stdin bytes, including NUL and invalid UTF-8, unless a rendering option is selected
deviations: no host paths, descriptor reopening, or process substitution

commands.name: ls
commands.binary: canonical virtual paths and separators; no host path formatting
deviations: long, human, time-sort, ownership, inode, and filesystem metadata are rejected when the backend does not provide them

commands.name: find
commands.effects: metadata-only bounded traversal and literal glob matching
deviations: -exec, -ok, -delete, -print, -ls, -prune, regexes, symlink following, and actions are rejected

commands.name: du
commands.effects: reports logical virtual entry sizes from backend metadata
commands.binary: decimal byte totals, tab, canonical virtual path

commands.name: head
commands.effects: returns a bounded byte or line prefix from virtual files/stdin
commands.binary: byte mode preserves arbitrary bytes; line mode preserves delimiters
deviations: signed counts, follow mode, host files, and implicit process streams are rejected

commands.name: tail
commands.effects: returns a bounded byte or line suffix from virtual files/stdin
commands.binary: byte mode preserves arbitrary bytes; line mode preserves delimiters
deviations: follow/watch, signed counts, host files, and process streams are rejected

commands.name: wc
commands.effects: counts lines, ASCII-whitespace words, and bytes
commands.binary: counts raw bytes without UTF-8 conversion; output is ASCII decimal text
deviations: character count, maximum line length, debug, files-from, locale, and host metadata are rejected

commands.name: grep
commands.effects: searches literal bytes/lines with bounded KMP matching
commands.binary: NUL and invalid UTF-8 are matched as bytes; labels are canonical virtual paths
deviations: regex syntax, long options, clusters, repeated -r, shell actions, and host PATH lookup are rejected

commands.name: sed
commands.effects: streams stdin or one virtual file through p/d or literal s/old/new/[g]
commands.binary: bounded byte-oriented line processing without locale or Unicode conversion
deviations: only p, d, and literal substitution are supported; scripts, regexes, writes, and multiple operands are rejected

excluded_from_profile.name: command
excluded_from_profile.reason: registry lookup helper requiring caller-provided registry context

excluded_from_profile.name: env
excluded_from_profile.reason: caller-environment inspection helper; not part of the FFI request contract

excluded_from_profile.name: type
excluded_from_profile.reason: registry lookup helper requiring caller-provided registry context

excluded_from_profile.name: which
excluded_from_profile.reason: registry lookup helper; no host PATH semantics

unsupported_option_contract.disclosure: never echo the rejected option, operand, host path, backend error, or environment value
